headline: Kenyan Manufacturers Urge Government to Cut Power Costs and Tax Burden
summary: Kenyan industrial producers have asked the national government to reduce commercial operating costs. Recommendations include lower electricity tariffs, predictable tax rules, and eliminating overlapping fees.
why: High power prices and changing tax frameworks affect manufacturing margins and industrial competitiveness across East Africa.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: High energy prices and compliance burdens restrict domestic industrial output growth.
